summary: Independent adversarial verification of Pillar 1 (Rollback v2) — 25/25 backend tests PASS. Covered: (a) auth gating — all 7 endpoints [POST /snapshot, GET /snapshots, POST /preview, POST /execute, GET /attempts, POST /drill, GET /drills] correctly reject unauthenticated and non-admin callers with 401/403 (14 parametrized cases); (b) real snapshot creation against polarisbuiltinc-wq/auremdev main — snapshot_id 'snap_' prefix, r2_key present, base_commit_sha non-empty string, file_manifest shows backend/main.py present:true with sha256 and nonexistent/file.py present:false; (c) GET /snapshots contains the created snapshot, no _id leakage anywhere; (d) preview returns ok:true with preview_token and expires_in_min=15, backend/main.py status='unchanged' (no drift); (e) execute confirm:false → ok:false reason 'confirm_required'; (f) bogus preview_token → ok:false 'preview_token_invalid'; (g) real token + confirm:true → EXPECTED fail-closed: ok:false reason 'restore_commit_failed', attempt_id 'rba_' prefix, detail contains 403, no ghp_/github_pat_/env-token leakage in detail; (h) attempts ledger contains the failed attempt with mechanism='snapshot_restore', result='failed', failure_reason + timestamp populated, no _id; (i) same preview_token reused → ok:false 'preview_token_already_used' (single-use enforced); (j) POST /drill returns result 'blocked' with steps[0]={step:'config',status:'blocked'} and drill_id appears in GET /drills; (k) regression — /auth/login and /admin/synthetic-checks/heartbeat both 200.
critical_code_review_comments: services/rollback_two_phase.py:128 — expiry check compares ISO-8601 strings via lexicographic '>', which is safe only because both timestamps are UTC 'Z-normalized' via datetime.isoformat() with tzinfo=utc (offset '+00:00'). Works today but a mixed-offset value would silently miscompare; safer to parse to datetime and compare.

services/rollback_two_phase.py:192-194 — secret scrubbing only replaces the exact `token` value passed in. Good, but if the GitHub library ever includes token fragments (partial), scrubbing won't catch it. Consider a regex sweep for ghp_/github_pat_/gho_ patterns in error detail before returning.

routers/rollback_v2.py:24-26 — _env_token() returns '' when both AUREM_DRILL_TOKEN and GITHUB_ACTIONS_TOKEN are unset; downstream services call GitHub with token='' which produces the 403 fail-closed observed here. Behavior is correct (fail-closed) but worth an explicit early-return with reason 'no_write_token_configured' on /execute for clearer operator UX.

services/rollback_snapshot.py:98 — env_config is just a copy of db_state['project_config'] rather than actual env fields; the key name is slightly misleading. Rename to project_config_snapshot or add real env allow-list.
Non-admin gating parametrized across all 7 endpoints returned 401/403 consistently — no bypass on GET vs POST.
